name: @sharedid-edge/module-tag-gateway
description: SharedID Edge module (opt-in): serves Google's tag gateway for advertisers from a path on the site, forwarding to *.fps.goog only when privacy signals allow

sharedidEdge.name: tag-gateway
sharedidEdge.title: Google's tag gateway for advertisers on your own path
sharedidEdge.summary: Nothing in the payload but its `forwards` report: serves the Google tag and its measurement requests from a path on your site (`/metrics`), forwarding them to Google's tag gateway (`<tag ID>.fps.goog`), with the client IP and location only when consent allows, and nothing on opt-out, COPPA, GPC (by default) or without TCF purposes 1 and 7 where GDPR applies
